propositions: dc_store_copy_repo fixture fails on git fetch origin tickets with exit status 128 but swallows git's stderr, making the root cause undiagnosable
subprocess.run with capture_output=True and check=True discards git's error message, leaving only the exit code in CalledProcessError's string form
the fetch is an un-retried single network call on the critical path, so any transient blip causes an ERROR that takes the cell out
git archive and git ls-tree calls in the same fixture use the identical failure-obscuring shape
a new _run_git helper must capture output but check exit status itself, raising RuntimeError with verbatim stderr plus remote, branch and status
fetch_tickets helper must retry the fetch a bounded number of times with backoff before final failure, using retry-then-fail policy so genuine misconfiguration still reds the lane
